title: Travere Therapeutics Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
summary: U.S. net product sales of FILSPARI reached $103 million, representing 108% growth compared to prior year period; all-time high 908 new PSFs received during the quarter U.S. net product sales of FILSPARI totaled $322 million for full year 2025; total net product sales were $410 million for full year 2025 PDUFA target action date for FILSPARI in FSGS is April 13, 2026; Company positioned for a successful commercial launch, if approved Enrollment activities have resumed for the pivotal Phase 3 HARMONY Study of pegtibatinase in classical HCU Travere Therapeutics, Inc.
